title: Content — Draft from a validated revision

forms.title: Content — Draft from a validated revision

actions.code: const x={{ json . }}; if(x.confirmation_manuelle!=="oui") throw new Error("manual_confirmation_required"); return {dossier_id:x.dossier_id,entreprise:x.entreprise,sujet:x.sujet,proposal_id:x.proposal_id};

const m={{ json .memory.data }}; const x={{ json .request }}; if(m.status!=="validated"||m.proposal_id!==x.proposal_id||!m.answer||!Array.isArray(m.citations)||!m.citations.length||Date.parse(m.expires_at)<=Date.now()) throw new Error("validated_memory_required"); return {facts:m.answer,source:m.citations.join("; ")+" [revision "+m.proposal_id+"]"};
const x={{ json .request }}; const v={{ json .validated }}; return {dossier_id:x.dossier_id,entreprise:x.entreprise,sujet:x.sujet,faits:v.facts,source_ref:v.source,confirmation_manuelle:true};
const record = {{ json .record }}; const review = {{ json .review.data }}; return {...record,decision:review,review_scope:"internal_draft_only"};
